bestBets.overview: BREAK THE LINE chase home Stoops here at his third outing. He has been kept fresh for this. ALSACE GEM had a good run in transit on debut before tiring in the run to the line. She was runner-up in a Murray Bridge jumpout on August 13th. DEFY GRAVITY and SHARE THE FIZZ filled the placings behind Vamore in a Quorn maiden last weekend. The latter wears blinkers for the first time today. ELECTRIC BEEL (formerly trained by Phillip & Tommy Stokes) hasn't shown a great deal in either of two starts but she may improve in this company.

raceTips.comment: Defy Gravity improved when 2nd behind Vamore at Quorn last time. He draws the middle and looks ready to win. Break The Line was runner-up here behind Stoops last time and should be in the mix from a sticky gate. Alsace Gem is in the Michael Hickmott yard and was 6th on debut at Naracoorte and finished 2nd in a jump-out since. Mouse In The House drops sharply in class from a Parks maiden won by Super Wonder.

bestBets.overview: UNCLE BARRY absolutely annihilated the opposition at Roxby Downs last start, winning by 13.67 lengths! He has raced well here in the past and has drawn favourably in barrier 1. OUR DIVINYL got the money at Roxby Downs two starts ago, then struggled in town last week. FINNBAR MCCOOL (formerly trained by Garret Lynch) won a maiden at Roxby Downs three weeks ago. He was good in a leader dominated race at Balaklava the start prior. THE HASS and TESTING ONE TWO (ex Michael Hickmott) are others that could be worth including in multiples.

raceTips.comment: Uncle Barry is coming off a 13 length Roxby win and draws the inside gate. bestBets.overview: HUBRISTIC has won two races from her past four starts, both here. From barrier 2 she can push forward and take up a handy position. STAR CASINO will be hard to hold out despite the fact that he has to carry 64.5kg. He has drawn favourably in barrier 1. THE GRUMP got the money at Roxby Downs two starts ago, then was narrowly beaten at Quorn last time. JE CITY won at Balaklava two starts ago. He was found to be lame after failing to beat a runner home in town last time. CHEF MILITAIRE has been comfortably accounted for in recent outings but is capable of better.

raceTips.comment: Star Casino has won six of his 10 starts here and was 3rd here last time behind Kikorangi carrying 66.5kg, the claim is a bonus. Hubristic was a winner here two runs back and then 2nd behind The Gump at Roxby, who then went and ran 2nd at Quorn last time out. Chef Militaire was placed here behind Star Casino three runs back and draws out. Je City was a Balaklava winner two runs back and another drawn awkwardly.
